grammar.composition_primitive: Dark full-bleed section; short text block aligned left; large product UI capture sits below/in the same column and occupies most of the first viewport; customer marks form a narrow footer row.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: White sans-serif heading; compact supporting sentence; CTA labels restrained; brand marks are small and subordinate.
grammar.typography_observation: White sans-serif heading; compact supporting sentence; CTA labels restrained; brand marks are small and subordinate.
grammar.media_observation: Product interface image is the hero proof asset, framed by dark field; crop is contained, not edge-to-edge photo.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Dense product proof in entry, followed by discrete workflow sections; each later section receives one focused UI view.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Text and CTA stack above the UI; interface remains legible as a contained image with reduced width; lower brand strip wraps/crops at viewport edge.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: heading, supporting copy, CTA, customer marks, semantic section. Asset: product UI screenshots as responsive images or live product mock only when separately implemented. Background: solid dark CSS. Do not imply the static screenshot is interactive.
misuse_constraints: Needs actual product UI evidence and permission to display; avoid fabricated interface states.
Product screenshot text must stay legible at mobile size or be replaced by a purpose-built crop.
Static screenshot does not establish motion, hover, or interaction.

grammar.composition_primitive: Soft blue proposition area with product UI illustration; two equal-width audience cards sit as a paired row beneath; each card has its own action and short qualifier.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Headline centered/left in the hero; audience labels bold; supporting qualifiers compact; actions visually parallel.
grammar.typography_observation: Headline centered/left in the hero; audience labels bold; supporting qualifiers compact; actions visually parallel.
grammar.media_observation: Product UI illustration supports the proposition but does not dominate the route choice.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Hero/product view, paired choice panels, then supporting service modules.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Cards become vertically stacked with equal prominence; each action stays inside its own card; proposition precedes both.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: semantic choice cards, headings and buttons; product UI as responsive image; CSS grid collapses to one column.
misuse_constraints: Only use two paths if the audience split is real and mutually understandable.
Do not make one path look like an unwanted default unless sales logic requires it.
UI image is not a substitute for product explanation.
